english.note: This is the all-purpose choice, especially for an admired entertainer and also for a revered idol in religious contexts.
Use 偶像 as the all-purpose choice for a highly admired person who serves as a model or outstanding example.

examples.english: I really admired that idol when I was young.
examples.traditional: 我細個嗰陣好崇拜嗰個偶像。
examples.jyutping: ngo5 sai3 go3 go2 zan6 hou2 sung4 baai3 go2 go3 ngau5 zoeng6

examples.english: They have always been an icon to me.
examples.traditional: 佢一直都係我心目中嘅偶像。
